task_spec.refined_instruction: First, move the yellow_mug from the orange_tray to the cyan_tray. Before doing so, confirm that the cyan_tray is empty; if not, clear it first. Then, move the blue_book from its current location (not on any zone) to the orange_tray. Before placing it, ensure the orange_tray is empty; if not, clear it first. After each placement, verify that the object is correctly positioned on its target zone. Success is achieved when the yellow_mug is on the cyan_tray and the blue_book is on the orange_tray, with no other objects on those zones.
